purpose: Teach: 本島/丹波/三条/名護/代々木/松戸/加賀/小田原

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが沖縄本島、つまり本島の写真集観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is looking at a photo collection of Okinawa's main island.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Light, conversational tone. Gentle pace — sharing a small domestic observation. Voice settles comfortably on the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと京都丹波の黒豆茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had Tamba black bean tea together.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick pace on the opening — excited to share. Unguarded and genuine. Small smile in the tone. Wants her attention and approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新潟県三条市の包丁を新調されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has gotten new knives from Sanjo, Niigata.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Slightly slower pace. A small note of interest — noticing something about him. Warm but measured, the way she mentions details she's picked up on.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと沖縄県名護市の海中映像観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched underwater footage from Nago, Okinawa.
lines.style: Animated voice, quick cadence. Eager to report. The brightness of a child sharing something wonderful he saw. Open-hearted delivery — seeking her delight in what delighted him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが代々木八幡神社のお祭りに行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is apparently going to the Yoyogi Hachimangu festival.
lines.style: Conversational, slightly anticipatory tone. Even pace. A hint of interest — something upcoming, worth mentioning. Composed but attentive, the way she relays what he's up to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと千葉県松戸市の歴史本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a history book about Matsudo, Chiba together.
lines.style: Warm, eager voice. Quick, genuine delivery. Proud to report another shared moment. Unguarded brightness. Seeking her recognition of the time spent together.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが石川県加賀温泉のパンフ取り寄せされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has ordered a pamphlet from Kaga Hot Springs in Ishikawa.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Unhurried pace. A small note of tenderness — noticing what captures his attention. Warm and knowing, the way a spouse notices the small plans being made.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと神奈川県小田原のかまぼこ取り寄せ食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I ordered and ate kamaboko from Odawara, Kanagawa.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied voice. Quick, natural pace. The warmth of a small pleasure shared. Eager to close the conversation with this final gift. Open and happy — wanting her to feel included in the joy.
